title: Object keys sort by ASCII code point, uppercase before lowercase
description: Keys are restricted to printable ASCII precisely so this ordering is unambiguous: JavaScript compares strings by UTF-16 code unit and Python by code point, and the two disagree above the BMP. Within ASCII they cannot. Note that `Z` sorts before `a`, which is not alphabetical order and is the case most likely to be got wrong by a hand-rolled comparator.
